{{Short description|Football match}} {{Infobox football match | title = 2024 Coupe de France final | image = File:Lille vs PSG 2019 - Stade Pierre Mauroy.jpg | image_size = 285px | caption = The [[Stade Pierre-Mauroy]] hosted the final. | event = [[2023–24 Coupe de France]] | team1 = [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] | team1association = [[Ligue 1]] | team1score = 1 | team2 = [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] | team2association = [[Ligue 1]] | team2score = 2 | details = | date = {{Start date|2024|5|25|df=y}} | stadium = [[Stade Pierre-Mauroy]] | city = [[Villeneuve-d'Ascq]] | man_of_the_match1a = | referee = [[François Letexier]]{{cite web |url=https://www.fff.fr/article/12483-letexier-dirigera-la-finale.html |title=Letexier dirigera la finale |trans-title=Benoît Millot will referee the final |publisher=[[French Football Federation]] |date=13 May 2024 |access-date=13 May 2024 |language=fr}} | attendance = 46,577 | weather = | previous = [[2023 Coupe de France final|2023]] | next = [[2025 Coupe de France final|2025]] }} The '''2024 Coupe de France final''' was a [[association football|football]] match between [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] and [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] to decide the winner of the [[2023–24 Coupe de France]], the 107th season of the [[Coupe de France]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fff.fr/article/12280-l-ol-s-en-va-en-finale.html|website=FFF.fr|language=fr|title=L'OL s'en va en finale|access-date=3 April 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.fff.fr/article/12287-le-psg-fidele-au-rendez-vous.html|website=FFF.fr|language=fr|title=Le PSG fidèle au rendez-vous|access-date=4 April 2024}} Due to the upgrade works at the [[Stade de France]] for the [[2024 Summer Olympics|Olympic Games]] and [[2024 Summer Paralympics|Paralympics]], the final was relocated to the [[Stade Pierre-Mauroy]] in [[Villeneuve-d'Ascq]]. This marked the first time in the history of the competition that a final was contested outside [[Paris]] (or its [[Banlieue#Paris|near suburbs]]).{{cite web|title=CdF : le stade où se jouera la finale est connu|url=https://www.footmercato.net/a2630589406131087662-cdf-le-stade-ou-se-jouera-la-finale-est-connu|publisher=Foot Mercato|language=fr|date=7 March 2023}}{{cite web|title=Le lieu de la finale de la Coupe de France enfin dévoilé|url=https://www.sofoot.com/breves/le-lieu-de-la-finale-de-la-coupe-de-france-est-connu|website=So Foot|language=fr|date=7 March 2023}} Paris Saint-Germain won the match 2–1 for their record-extending fifteenth Coupe de France title.{{cite news|url=https://www.ligue1.com/Articles/Other-Competitions/2024/05/25/coupe-de-france-final-dembele-powers-psg|title=Coupe de France Final: Dembélé powers PSG|date=25 May 2024|website=Ligue
